en.headline: Productivity Council opens Hong Kong's first embodied AI robot training ground
en.dek: The facility under the Hong Kong Productivity Council brings together technology and scene partners to test humanoid and other robots in real industrial, logistics and public-service settings.
body: The Hong Kong Productivity Council said it has established the city's first training ground focused on embodied artificial intelligence and real-scene applications of humanoid robots.

The Embodied Intelligence International Application Training Ground, set up under the council's Hong Kong Industrial Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Centre, provides environments for technical research, model training, system verification and scenario testing. In its first phase it has gathered seven technology partners and eight international scene partners covering industrial manufacturing, smart logistics, retail services, inspection and maintenance, and public services.

Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong, speaking at the opening, said humanoid robots and embodied AI have the potential to transform industrial operations and generate new productive forces. He noted that Hong Kong's research base and international links make it suitable for testing and commercialisation, and that the facility should help produce more globally applicable success cases to support new industrialisation.

zh.headline: 生產力局成立本港首個具身智能及人形機械人訓練場
zh.dek: 香港工業人工智能與機械人研發中心設立「具身智能國際應用訓練場」，匯聚技術及場景夥伴，推動機械人在工業、物流及公共服務等實景測試。
body: 生產力促進局宣布，轄下香港工業人工智能與機械人研發中心成立全港首個專注於具身智能及人形機械人實景應用的「具身智能國際應用訓練場」。
訓練場提供真實應用環境，集技術研發、模型訓練、系統驗證及場景測試於一體。首階段匯聚7家技術夥伴及8家國際場景夥伴，涵蓋工業製造、智慧物流、零售服務、巡檢維護及公共服務等領域。
創新科技及工業局局長孫東在開幕致辭時表示，人形機械人與具身智能是新一輪科技創新的關鍵前沿，具有變革產業運作模式及催生新質生產力的潛力。他期望訓練場能推動更多全球應用的成功案例，為新型工業化注入新動能。
